reviews.title: Magnetic Switches and Adjustable Actuation — A Solid Upgrade from Razer
reviews.comment: recently upgraded from a Razer Huntsman Elite with their Light Optical Purple switches, and I’m very impressed with the Apex Pro TKL Gen 3. The OmniPoint magnetic switches with adjustable actuation are amazing. I thought it might be a gimmick, but being able to set the key press height is actually super useful. The Rapid Tap feature is there if you want it. I haven’t had a real need for it yet, but the concept is solid. Key sound is very satisfying — a nice solid thump without being overly clicky like the purple switches. LED lighting looks great, and the SteelSeries software is much better than Razer Synapse in my experience. Overall, the typing and gaming experience feels solid, customizable, and high-quality. I’m really happy with the upgrade.
reviews.author: Devin H

reviews.title: Unreal feel and performance — my new go-to gaming keyboard
reviews.comment: I recently upgraded to this keyboard and I honestly don’t see how anyone could give it anything less than 5 stars. My previous keyboard was a fully mechanical unit with Cherry MX Brown switches, so I had a good benchmark—and this one absolutely stands out. The keystrokes are super fast and precise—if you’ve ever watched keyboard ASMR videos and thought “I want that,” this is it. Gaming performance is fantastic. Every input feels responsive, smooth, and satisfying. Uses USB-C  for modern, reliable connection. One of the killer features is the adjustable actuation pressure: I can dial in exactly how far I need to press a key  (0.1mm to 4.0 mm) range, and that significantly reduces accidental key-presses. The lighting quality is excellent. The customizable RGB effects are rich and make it easy to match the keyboard to any build or desk setup. The form factor and build feel premium: the tenkeyless layout keeps things compact (my desktop is less cluttered) and the materials feel incredibly solid. I’m completely sold on this keyboard! It is the perfect fir for those who heavily type for long hours or a gamer looking to maximize their setup. Overall rating: ★★★★★ (5/5) In my experience, this keyboard delivers an exceptional blend of feel, responsiveness, customization, and build quality. If you’ve been looking for a keyboard that not only works great but feels great to use every day—this is one of the best I’ve tried.
reviews.author: Jake

reviews.title: Excellent Feel
reviews.comment: Great Keyboard. The keys feel great for magnetic switches and the adjustable actuation points are a perfect for gaming. LEDs look beautiful and vibrant and the screen I can add custom GIFs to is a nice plus.
reviews.author: FRP

reviews.title: Great for the price, feels great!
reviews.comment: Bought this for my son for Xmas and he is a big gamer.  I was lucky enough to try it and it is awesome.  I love gaming as well and the Feel, looks, and ergonomics of this keyboard cannot be beat. The keys feel responsive and smooth.  The actuator slider is amazing, it will either make your key strokes more or less sensitive to pressure so in FPS games is can be a real game changer. The RGB is nice and pretty standard.  I do like that they sent a wrist support.  I can no longer play M&K due to tendonitis in my arm, so anything that supports better ergonomics, especially for younger players is a bonus. The Keyboard is smaller in size and feels very sturdy.  My son goes through keyboards like tennis shoes, and this one seems like it is built to last. I really enjoy this keyboard and if I could still use M&K I would buy on for myself!
